# P0-05 provider-response fixture

Source: https://serpapi.com/maps-place-results (official SerpAPI Google Maps Place Results API response example, Stumptown Coffee Roasters). Retrieved 2026-11-03.

This is an anonymized **excerpt of the published response example**, not a new paid/live API capture. The docs contain ellipses; omitted fields/days have not been invented. `type` (array), `rating` (4.5), `reviews` (1388), and `hours` (list of weekday dictionaries, three published entries) retain their published values and structure.

Name, website, address, phone, data_id and place_id are replaced with synthetic values. Other fields, including image links and review details, are omitted. No photo count or operating_hours appears in this example; alias/empty/error/zero coverage uses explicitly synthetic test inputs. No credentials, customer responses, or review texts are stored.
